name: fan-in-5
note: Fan-in: nodes 1,2,3 each owe 10 to node 0; node 0 owes 30 to node 4; 4 owes nothing. p̄=[30,10,10,10,0]. e ≫ 0 (ε=0,5 dyadic, exact). base: nodes 1-3 each pay 0,5; node 0 receives 1,5, pays 0,5+1,5=2 ⇒ p*=[2, 0,5, 0,5, 0,5, 0]. bumped (e₁,e₂,e₃: +1 each): nodes 1-3 pay 1,5; node 0 pays 0,5+4,5=5 ⇒ p*=[5, 1,5, 1,5, 1,5, 0]. Δp*=[3,1,1,1,0]: ‖Δp*‖∞=3 > ‖Δe‖∞=1 (L∞ amplification = 3 EXACTLY, by convergence of 3 unit shocks on a single node) and ‖Δp*‖₁=6 = 2·‖Δe‖₁. Refutes the nonexpansiveness of e↦p* in BOTH the L1 and L∞ norms, on a regular and unique system.
